Why Independence Events

The Factory Workers is one of South Jersey's most distinctive event spaces — a converted 1920s movie theater with exposed plaster, reclaimed wood, and a yellow submarine. It deserves sound and lighting that's just as intentional.

We've played every kind of room. We know how to make yours sing.
